description: ... [Darren] has demonstrated a rare ability to listen, build consensus, and take decisive action. As his brother, I’ve seen his tireless work ethic; as his colleague, I’ve seen his professional excellence; and as his neighbor, I’ve seen his heart in this community. Darren isn't just running for office to hold a title—he’s running because he truly cares. He has a proven track record of making things better wherever he goes.
title: Nathan Croft - Darren Croft for Utah House District 41
